设计意图： Mutation of the momentum-gated value-quality crossover: simplify by removing the quality leg and the regime gate, retaining only the core value mechanism (sales yield discounted by financial leverage). This preserves the strong RankIC/ICIR from the value component while reducing complexity. The leverage penalty ensures cheapness is not spurious from high debt.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

(1/ps_ttm) * clip(1 - debttoassets/100, 0, 1)
依赖列: ps_ttm, debttoassets

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

(1/ps_ttm) * clip(1 - debttoassets/100, 0, 1)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(divide(1, ps_ttm), clip(subtract(1, divide(debttoassets, 100)), 0, 1))
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, ps_ttm)
  3. 3. clip —— 裁剪到区间[下限,上限]
    clip(subtract(1, divide(debttoassets, 100)), 0, 1)
  4. 4. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(1, divide(debttoassets, 100))
  5. 5. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(debttoassets, 100)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
debttoassets资产负债率（杠杆字段）
ps_ttm市销率 TTM（估值字段）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 sales_yield：1.0 / ps_ttm
  2. 计算 safe_debt：np.clip(1.0 - debttoassets / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)
  3. 计算 factor：sales_yield * safe_debt
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_sales_yield_leverage_adjusted(df): df_copy = df.copy() sales_yield = 1.0 / df_copy["ps_ttm"].replace(0, np.nan) safe_debt = np.clip(1.0 - df_copy["debttoassets"] / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0) factor = sales_yield * safe_debt "kw">class="kw">return pd.Series(factor, index=df_copy.index, name="factor_sales_yield_leverage_adjusted")
